title: Chronicle replayer: deterministic stream snapshot validator and fixture adapter for SDK contract tests
creator: Maya Chen
description: Implement a deterministic session replayer called 'Chronicle' that converts recorded multi-turn streaming sessions into time-indexed, canonical snapshots for cross-language SDK contract tests. The goal is to validate retry semantics, partial-frame resume/rewind behavior, and ordering determinism across Python/TS/Go SDKs without relying on live Redwood endpoints. Chronicle will include an adapter layer to emit VCR-like fixtures and a validator that asserts token-level contract expectations (ordering, missing-chunk reconstructions, and canonical timestamps).
acceptance_criteria: Chronicle can ingest production session traces and produce canonical snapshots that are byte-stable across runs
SDK CI uses Chronicle fixtures to run contract tests that catch streaming retry regressions introduced by runtime changes
Validator reports deterministic assertions: out-of-order chunks, missing continuation tokens, and KV-cache mismatch with clear failure messages
End-to-end example added for Python/TS/Go showing replay -> validator -> pass/fail in CI (examples in repo/docs)
comments: 2025-11-19 - Maya Chen: Spike completed. Ingested three representative streaming sessions from production (chat, function-call-heavy, long-context completion) and exercised rewind/resume edgecases. Observed inconsistent ordering when we simulated low-level TCP chunk interleaving; Chronicle will normalize by event-timestamp and sequence-id.

2025-12-02 - Liam O'Connor: Implemented initial snapshot format (flat time-indexed frames). Pushed prototype parser in branch feat/chronicle-replayer. See PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1245. Unit tests for the parser included (Python harness).

2025-12-10 - Sara Patel (code review): Feedback: make validator errors machine-parseable (JSON lines) so CI can map failures to SDK owners; add a ttl normalization step for KV-cache frames. Added as follow-up tasks in sub_issues.

2026-01-15 - Infrastructure: Added optional latency-fuzz flag to chronicle runner to test SDK backoff and jitter handling. Early runs found flaky backoff behavior in TS SDK retry backoff calculation when a resumed stream reports a slightly older timestamp.

2026-02-20 - QA: Ran Chronicle fixtures across the cross-sdk runner and caught a regression in Go SDK where chunk boundary handling trimmed a continuation token. Filed ENG-21390 for the fix and added a targeted Chronicle fixture to prevent regression.

2026-03-10 - Liam O'Connor: Roadmap update: priority remains high for CI stability. Next steps: finalize adapter for VCR fixture export, implement JSONL machine-readable assertion output, add example run in SDK CI for next release. Preparing RFC for rollout of Chronicle fixtures into nightly CI (draft linked in attachments).
